arguments.subject: Project Alpha - Status Update
arguments.body:
Hi team,

Here's a quick status update on Project Alpha:

- API integration: The auth layer is complete, and the data sync layer is working well.
- Schedule: We're ahead of schedule. Data sync phase is expected to wrap up by end of week.

Please reply with any blockers or questions.

Thanks,
[Your name]
